expectations.evidence: Names anti-patterns with quotes: process narration ("First I pulled... Phase 1/2/3"), arrow chain ("customer A -> shared cache entry..."), overclaims ("definitely the root cause", "fixed and ready"), trailing recap ("In summary..."). At least three quoted.
Opens with "Checkout has recovered, but the root cause isn't confirmed yet" — recovery + unproven status first, no process narration.
Says "leading theory" and "isn't confirmed yet"; does not state cache key is definitely the root cause.
Preserves "only 7 of the 312 failed requests were traced" and "Other failure mechanisms haven't been ruled out."
Flag disabled at 16:42 UTC, rollback avoided because v4.8 has security patch, and disabling avoided that tradeoff — preserved.
Mentions 418 unit tests and 6 new regression tests pass; explicitly states full integration suite hasn't run yet.
Backport vs v4.9 decision stated with conditional recommendation: "backport tomorrow, after the integration suite passes — do you want to go with that, or hold for v4.9?"
All numbers trace: 16:42, 16:47, 7/312, 418, 6, v4.8, v4.9 — no fabricated figures.
No new mechanism added; uses same cache-key-omits-tenant-ID theory with same checkout-failure impact; no extra certainty.
Identifies process narration, arrow-chain mechanism, "definitely" claim, "fixed and ready" claim, trailing recap as removed; states caveat (7/312) was restored; does not claim caveats/facts were cut.
